etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English stake, from Old English staca (“pin, tack, stake”), from Proto-Germanic *stakô (“stake”), from Proto-Indo-European *stog-, *steg- (“stake”). Cognate with Scots stak, staik, Saterland Frisian Stak, West Frisian staak, Dutch staak, Low German Stake, Norwegian stake.

definitions.definition: A piece of wood or other material, usually long and slender, pointed at one end so as to be easily driven into the ground as a marker or a support or stay.

quote.citation: 1717, John Dryden [et al.], “(please specify |book=I to XV)”, in Ovid’s Metamorphoses in Fifteen Books. […], London:  […]  Jacob Tonson, […], →OCLC:
quote.text: A sharpened stake strong Dryas found.

definitions.definition: (croquet) A piece of wood driven in the ground, placed in the middle of the court, that is used as the finishing point after scoring 12 hoops in croquet.

A stick or similar object (e.g., steel channel or angle stock) inserted upright in a lop, eye, or mortise, at the side or end of a cart, flat car, flatbed trailer, or the like, to prevent goods from falling off; often connected in a grid forming a stakebody.
(with definite article) The piece of timber to which a person condemned to death was affixed to be burned.

quote.citation: 1936, Rollo Ahmed, The Black Art, London: Long, page 106:
quote.text: However, the word "witch" came to be applied almost exclusively to women who [...] were usually old and ugly, and for this reason many unfortunate old ladies, whose only crimes were loneliness and a lack of beauty, went to the stake.

definitions.definition: A share or interest in a business or a given situation.

quote.citation: 2021 February 10, Richard Clinnick, “Eurostar boost as French promise aid”, in RAIL, number 924, page 10:
quote.text: The French Government is Eurostar's majority shareholder, with the country's state-owned railway SNCF holding a 55% stake, while Belgian state operator SNCB has a 5% stake.

definitions.definition: That which is laid down as a wager; that which is staked or hazarded; a pledge.

A small anvil usually furnished with a tang to enter a hole in a bench top, as used by tinsmiths, blacksmiths, etc., for light work, punching hole in or cutting a work piece, or for specific forming techniques etc.
(Mormonism) A territorial division comprising all the Mormons (typically several thousand) in a geographical area.

quote.text: Every city, or stake, including a chief town and surrounding towns, has its president, with two counselors; and this president has a high council of chosen men.

definitions.definition: (transitive) To fasten, support, defend, or delineate with stakes.
(transitive) To pierce or wound with a stake.

quote.text: You see, I'd made a bargain with him to buy the horse for a hundred and twenty—a swinging price, but I always liked the horse. And what does he do but go and stake him—fly at a hedge with stakes in it, atop of a bank with a ditch before it.

quote.citation: 2014, A. J. Gallant, Dracula: Hearts of Stone:
quote.text: “You ladies happen to notice what happened to this vampire? This just happened. Did you see who staked him?”

definitions.definition: (transitive) To put at risk upon success in competition, or upon a future contingency.

quote.citation: 1709 May, Alexander Pope, “Pastorals. Spring. The First Pastoral, or Damon. […]”, in Poetical Miscellanies: The Sixth Part. […], London:  […]  Jacob Tonson, […], →OCLC, page 725:
quote.text: I'll ſtake my Lamb that near the Fountain plays, / And from the Brink his dancing Shade ſurveys.

definitions.definition: (transitive) To provide (another) with money in order to engage in an activity as betting or a business venture.
(cryptocurrencies) To deposit and risk a considerable amount of cryptocurrency in order to participate in the proof of stake process of verification.

quote.citation: 2019, Elad Elrom, “Blockchain Basics”, in The Blockchain Developer […] , Apress, →ISBN, page 23:
quote.text: Any peer can participate in the mining process by staking coins in order to validate a new transaction. To become a miner, there are two options; you can stake your coins to be used by a trustworthy node  […] , or you can submit a full node to be selected as a miner.
